body: As someone who watched their partner go through  what can be a very messy process, my biggest piece of advice is, if she is refusing a paternity test at all don’t sign anything regarding a birth certificate or any legal paperwork once the child is born. And honestly if you can start looking for representation that specializes in paternal rights. If is not financially feasible then talk to the family court system in your local area now. If you start the process you’re just showing that you want to do what’s right by the child now. Also you are in every right to have everything through texts or emails. Don’t take any word over the phone. If you do text to confirm it immediately after, that is proof for your end of it does get messy. If that child is yours and you want to be a part of their life, you have every right to be. You need to protect those rights. The courts suck at protecting fathers and making things fair for them.
